verdict.rationale: Zulip documents export tools for moving between Zulip Cloud and your own servers ([zulip-docs-6], [zulip-docs-10]), including public data plus consented private channel and direct messages ([zulip-docs-14]). The export can be imported into a self-hosted server running the same 100% FOSS software ([zulip-docs-7], [zulip-docs-8], [zulip-comm-8]), so leaving is a real, documented path. However, the export is organization-level and admin-driven rather than clearly per-user, and nothing states the export format is open or usable outside Zulip. Missing for 10: evidence that exports use open or standard formats, documented individual-user self-service export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full export-and-leave.
